Daily Devotional

July 25

16 For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ. (1 Corinthians 2:16 KJV)

Those of us who have been born again, have brand new spirits (Galatians 4:6) and are completely new creatures (2 Corinthians 5:17). We have the very mind of Christ living in us, and our spirits have been renewed in knowledge after the one who created us (Colossians 3:10). Our spirits have been anointed so that we know all things (1 John 2:20).

Why don’t Christians become smarter than the rest of the world then? The problem is the new mind of Christ that is in our spirits, is not directly available to our carnal mind. The only way we can tap into this new spiritual mind is to renew our minds by studying the Word of God (Romans 12:2). As we read the Word, the Holy Spirit will quicken it (John 15:26), and begin to renew our physical mind, so that we can get the revelation knowledge from our spiritual minds into our physical minds. Why this works, is because the Word of God is spirit and life (John 6:63), so by reading the Word we will get the knowledge out of the spirit into the physical mind. Praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com

The Justice Department guidance says the goal is "to clear up some confusion and to be consistent in the way we draft our releases" and describes the particular way regional offices should refer to individuals in news releases.
